recommendation: Keep the FHIR-7088 audit commit and the FHIR-7340 source fix. Revisit only if a future generated Bundle example again emits broken links for the medication or patient references.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core-Feed correction reporting that both example links on http://hl7.org/fhir/2015May/bundle-example.html returned 404; the resolution was to fix the example links.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 6538 as the original application. In the Git mirror this is 9c63575a59ba53e36a3a2300c374e58741027ab0, whose message explicitly mentions #7088 and broken example links. That historical application was shared by the FHIR-7088/FHIR-7340 broken-link family and did not itself leave an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-7088 on the combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-7340 is a same-change-family Published/Persuasive issue for the same 2015May bundle-example URL, the same FHIR-core-Feed artifact, and the same svn revision 6538. The combined branch contains FHIR-7340 source commit 603d52dab8e1b0eeaa18fd28987936f563218d09, which changed the active Bundle searchset example from the stale Medication/example target to Medication/medicationexample1. The combined source also uses Patient/f001, and both Medication/medicationexample1 and Patient/f001 are active example-list targets. No issue-specific Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was published for FHIR-7088. The final combined branch already fixes the relevant current source through FHIR-7340, and combined commit 7d572eaf38094f4b0584e1337804bcc8ef8648c9 records FHIR-7088 as an empty no-change audit commit.
